database: SQLite at /data/pm.db (DATABASE_PATH). Schema version is PRAGMA user_version; db.initialize() applies migrations in order.

columns: session_key TEXT NOT NULL (rotated on password change)
user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id)
column_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES columns(id)
assignee_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) (the board's owner or a member | NULL)
archived_at TEXT (UTC | NULL for active cards; archived cards have position -1)
board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id)
user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) (author of a user message | NULL)
board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id)
user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id)
user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) (NULL once the author's account is deleted)
board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id)
user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) (NULL once the actor's account is deleted)
action TEXT NOT NULL (e.g. moved "Task" to Review)
card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id)
label TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE
card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id)

constraints: A user has one or more boards; the last one cannot be deleted.
boards.user_id is the owner; board_members lists the other users who can open the board.
Usernames are unique ignoring case (checked by the application).
Each board has five columns with fixed positions 0 through 4. Column and card ids are generated (col-<uuid>, card-<uuid>), except the seeded demo board's.
Active cards (archived_at IS NULL) are ordered by position (0..n-1) within their column; archived cards have position -1.
Cards are ordered by position (0..n-1) within their column.
Messages belong to a board and are ordered by created_at, then id.

Deleting a card deletes its comments, labels and checklist. Deleting a board or an account deletes its cards, labels, checklists, comments, columns, members, messages and activity in application code (the foreign keys have no ON DELETE CASCADE). Deleting an account also removes its memberships and clears its card assignments and the authorship of its messages, comments and activity.

migrations.1: Renumber card positions to 0..n-1 within each column.
migrations.2: Add users.password_hash and users.session_key; rebuild boards without UNIQUE(user_id) and with a name; add cards.priority and cards.due_date. Existing users get the demo password.
migrations.4: Add messages.user_id, set to the board owner for existing user messages.
